lines.zh: 我提着裙摆走在湿地上
lines.en: I walk the wet ground, holding up my hem.
A door in my way opens with one push.

lines.zh: 我在村道上走，眼睛盯着屋檐
lines.en: I walk the village road, eyes on the eaves.

lines.zh: 怪物藏在影子里，我一个个找
lines.en: Monsters hide in shadow; I seek them one by one.
My steps are not quick, but steady.

lines.zh: 圣徽在胸前晃，敲着衣料
lines.en: The holy sigil knocks against my clothes.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，不愿湿了鞋
lines.en: I step around puddles, unwilling to wet my shoes.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，那里最容易出事
lines.en: I walk the wall base, where trouble starts.

lines.zh: 我回头看了一眼刚才的路
lines.en: I glance back at the road I came by.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，空气安静一些
lines.en: The air grows quieter where I pass.

lines.zh: 我把木门推开，里面的屋子空了
lines.en: I push the wooden door open; the room is empty.

lines.zh: 我走向最暗的那间房子
lines.en: I head for the darkest house.
I stand in prayer, briefly.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有东西在动
lines.en: I listen for anything that moves.
The sigil in my hand is warm.

lines.zh: 我不怕它们，我只是不喜欢
lines.en: I do not fear them; I simply dislike them.

lines.zh: 这片村子的屋顶，灰尘太厚
lines.en: The dust on these roofs is too thick.
I know where they will come from.
I straighten my cuffs.
I have spoken the litany for many years.

lines.zh: 远处有脚步，我抬了抬头
lines.en: Footsteps far off; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 这一带的人，晚上不开窗
lines.en: People here do not open windows at night.

lines.zh: 我数着村子里亮着的灯
lines.en: I count the lamps still lit in the village.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在石板路上
lines.en: My shadow lies along the flagstones.

lines.zh: 风从海上过来，带着腥味
lines.en: The wind comes from the sea, carrying brine.

lines.zh: 我按住被风吹起的披巾
lines.en: I press down the scarf the wind lifts.
Faith runs thin here.
I do not sit; standing is quicker.

lines.zh: 我打量你身上有没有海腥味
lines.en: I check you for the smell of the sea.
You are human; that is good.

lines.zh: 我把圣徽举起来，只是让你看见
lines.en: I raise the sigil only for you to see it.
Do not linger in the doorway; come in.
You are hurt; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我不问你的名字，先问你怕不怕
lines.en: I ask not your name, but whether you are afraid.

lines.zh: 这里的夜不太平，跟着我走
lines.en: The night is not safe here; walk with me.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，是冷的还是怕的
lines.en: Your hands tremble; cold, or fear?

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，见过太多
lines.en: I know that look; I have seen it often.

lines.zh: 我不许你在这房子里过夜
lines.en: I will not let you spend the night in this house.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就知道答案了
lines.en: You step back; that tells me enough.
No need for courtesies between us.

lines.zh: 我抬手，是要你不要出声
lines.en: I raise a hand: stay silent.
I can hear it behind you.

lines.zh: 血从袖口渗出来，我按住
lines.en: Blood seeps through my sleeve; I press it.
The litany breaks off.
That landed on my armor.

lines.zh: 我按住伤处，血从指缝渗出
lines.en: I press the wound; blood seeps through my fingers.

lines.zh: 我的圣徽掉了，我捡起来
lines.en: My sigil fell; I pick it up.
I can bear this pain.
I put my back to the wall.
A corner of my hem turns red.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看着伤我的东西
lines.en: I look up at what struck me.
Strike me; I will not run.
I do not eat this; keep it.
My order has rules; I thank you nonetheless.
If you are hungry, eat it yourself.

lines.zh: 我接过来，只为了不让你难堪
lines.en: I take it only so you are not embarrassed.
This smell reminds me of the sea.

lines.zh: 我收进袖子，回头再处理
lines.en: I tuck it in my sleeve to deal with later.
I do not take what is not given.
Your kindness is noted.
That is not enough for a night.
I share it with those by the road.
You bump me; I hold without giving ground.

lines.zh: 裙摆绊了一下，我扶住墙
lines.en: My hem catches; I steady myself on the wall.
That was not courteous.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，圣徽响了
lines.en: We collide and the sigil rings.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，眼睛没离开
lines.en: I step aside, eyes never off you.
My armor caught that.
You should apologize after that.
I gesture for you to go first.
The flagstones are slick; steady yourself.
That much force will not move me.
I have taken vows; not this.
Among comrades, only standing side by side.

lines.zh: 我的誓约不包含这种事
lines.en: My vows do not cover such things.

lines.zh: 有怪物进来，我们先关门
lines.en: If something comes in, we shut the door first.
I will not break my vows for you.
If you leave, I see you to the village edge.
I will walk this road with you to the end.

lines.zh: 圣徽之下的信任，比别的重要
lines.en: Trust under the sigil matters more than other things.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，谁也不用说话
lines.en: We stand side by side, no words needed.
If I fall, you must continue the words.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，看了看，放回原处
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and put it back.
This should not be lying on the ground.
I gather the scattered things.
I take only what is useful.
I lift it; it has weight.
I hand it to the owner of the house.
There is blood on the ground; I step around it.
I pick up the sigil and wipe it clean.

lines.zh: 这里的东西，动过就要放回
lines.en: Anything moved here must be put back.
I keep nothing for myself.
Something over there is due for absolution.
It is behind you; step aside.
I raise the sigil and speak a phrase.

lines.zh: 它会从窗口进来，我盯着那里
lines.en: It will come through the window; I watch it.
The distance is enough.

lines.zh: 这个村子里，只有我能拦它
lines.en: In this village, only I can stop it.
I raise my hand, light gathering.
It moves, and so do I.
Do not interfere; stand by the wall.
It does not fear fire, but light.

lines.zh: 我认得这种气息，是海嗣
lines.en: I know this presence: the Seaborn.
One shot will do.

lines.zh: 我盯着窗口，一直没眨眼
lines.en: I watch the window without blinking.
It circles inside; I do not chase.
The door is pushed open; I walk toward it.
I recite the litany, voice steady.
It steps back, I step forward.

lines.zh: 我给屋里的人留了退路
lines.en: I left the people inside a way out.

lines.zh: 光在指间亮着，一直没散
lines.en: The light stays lit between my fingers.
It is outside the wall; I press to it.
I do not shout; it would startle it.
From this angle it cannot dodge.
Do not stand under the window.
Every move it makes, I note.
The wind has turned; it cannot smell me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，光从掌心打出去
lines.en: I raise my hand; light leaves my palm.
This blow is not to kill, but to drive off.
The sigil hisses against it.

lines.zh: 我推它一下，把它逼出门
lines.en: I shove it once to force it out the door.

lines.zh: 我的护甲挡住了它的爪子
lines.en: My armor stops its claws.
By the third line, the light grows brighter.
It retreats; I land one more.
I do not chase beyond this street.
That one took all my strength.
It falls, and I keep reciting.

lines.zh: 我推开木门，走进这间屋子
lines.en: I push the wooden door open and step in.
The bell rang; I was due to come.

lines.zh: 这里有人祈祷，我听见了
lines.en: Someone was praying here; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我不是自然来的，是有人叫我
lines.en: I did not come naturally; I was called.
I close the door behind me.

lines.zh: 屋里的灰很多，很久没人住
lines.en: Much dust here; empty a long while.
I hang the sigil at the doorway.

lines.zh: 风里有海的味道，太近了
lines.en: The wind smells of the sea, too close.
I count the people in the room.
Tonight I stay here.

lines.zh: 我提灯进屋，光晃了一下
lines.en: I bring the lamp in; the light sways.

lines.zh: 我提着药箱，从门里出来
lines.en: I come through the door with my medicine case.
I came from far away.
The room is quiet in the wrong way.
Fire catches my scarf; I smother it.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下，膝盖磕破了
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and cut my knee.

lines.zh: 水灌进口鼻，我抓不住东西
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I cannot grip anything.
The wall collapses; my robe catches fire.
An arrow grazes my shoulder.
That force presses down my prayer.
Fasting too long; my hands tremble.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮整条街，我闭了眼
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole street; I shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石板路，只有空
lines.en: No flagstones below, only void.
